{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
print("Number of unique patient_id:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(data))

# Check how many duplicates there are
patient_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple records: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"Total number of duplicate rows: {len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Show the highest sample_seq per patient
highest_seq = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print("Highest sample_seq per patient:")
print(highest_seq.head())"}
